# ANGRAMM®

> ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally.

ANGRAMM was born in Marseille. We imagine, shoot and finish films for brands, clubs and artists, from street documentary to full CGI. We work as one crew, from the first idea to the final grade, with the same obsession: images that feel true to the places and the people they come from.

Based in Marseille, France. Contact: contact@angramm.com

## Films

- [Olympique de Marseille 26/27](https://angramm.com/work/om/) (2026): A film for Olympique de Marseille unveiling the 2026/27 kit. Live action and CGI meet in a cinematic expedition, from the stands to the heart of a blue-lit volcano.
- [KAPPA x US ENDOUME](https://angramm.com/work/endoume-kappa/) (2026): The new kit of US Endoume Catalans, a neighbourhood club founded in 1925, worn through the streets, beaches and creeks of Marseille, from Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde to the Vallon des Auffes.
- [FAMILY 3.0 x LACOSTE FW26](https://angramm.com/work/lacoste/) (2026): An elevator, a single floor and a vinyl session: Lacoste's FW26 collection, created with Family 3.0 and filmed in chiaroscuro between record shelves and sound systems.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK (KYAN, São Paulo)](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-vrunk-sao-paulo/) (2026): The Mizuno × Vrunk collection in São Paulo with KYAN: sneakers, tracksuits and the city's alleys, cut to the rhythm of the street.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK (Rio de Janeiro)](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-rio/) (2026): A Rio de Janeiro favela lights up: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection told through hustle, energy and light, from rooftop barbers to a logo glowing over the city.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK (Ven1, Nanterre)](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-vrunk/) (2025): Motocross, drifting and CGI: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection staged with Ven1 among the towers of Nanterre, under a rain of petals.
- [Olympique de Marseille x CMA CGM](https://angramm.com/work/om-cma-cgm/): The Olympique de Marseille squad lands at the port of Marseille to unveil the new kit sponsored by CMA CGM, shot among the containers and the dockers who keep the port running.
- [ADIDAS x FAMILY 3.0](https://angramm.com/work/adidas-adizero/) (2025): From orbit to asphalt: the adidas Adizero Evo SL with Family 3.0, mixing CGI with a run at first light.
- [FAMILY 3.0 x LACOSTE FW24](https://angramm.com/work/lacoste-fw24/) (2025): Binoculars, boats and calanques: Lacoste's FW24 collection, created with Family 3.0 and shot in Marseille.
- [UMBRO x SAiSON x Chroniques2mars](https://angramm.com/work/umbro/) (2024): A neighbourhood pitch below Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde and the man who paints its lines: a film for Umbro, SAiSON and Chroniques2mars about grassroots football in Marseille.
- [CROCS x SAiSON x Chroniques2mars](https://angramm.com/work/crocs-saison/) (2024): Crocs lands in Marseille with SAiSON and Chroniques2mars: a mock news flash, street football and Crocs by the sea for a limited-edition drop.
